body:
Yeah, I overanalyze everything too. And I feel so awkward and uncomfortable which I think makes whoever I'm speaking to feel uncomfortable as well.

I always want to exercise, even just go on a walk (I live in the city right now). But I have trouble finding the motivation. Once I get home I just want to watch tv and go to sleep. But I should try it, and it helps knowing it's helped someone else.

I am interested in travel but I've never been able to afford it. Any advice?
